description: The line plot illustrates the performance of two different models, "Recall@50 (Ours)" and "NDCG@50 (Ours)," as well as their counterparts "Recall@50 (ReFICR)" and "NDCG@50 (ReFICR)," across five different depths of search. The x-axis represents the depth of search, ranging from 1 to 5. The y-axis on the left measures the Recall@50, ranging from 0.30 to 0.60, while the y-axis on the right measures the NDCG@50, ranging from 0.15 to 0.22. The "Recall@50 (Ours)" line, represented by a solid green line with circle markers, shows a steady increase in performance as the depth of search increases, starting at approximately 0.35 and reaching about 0.55. The "NDCG@50 (Ours)" line, depicted by a solid blue line with square markers, also shows a steady increase, starting at around 0.16 and reaching about 0.19. The "Recall@50 (ReFICR)" line, shown as a dashed green line with circle markers, remains constant at approximately 0.21 across all depths of search. The "NDCG@50 (ReFICR)" line, represented by a dashed blue line with square markers, remains constant at around 0.19. The plot does not include any peaks, declines, or steady trends beyond the data points provided.
